note: Current scope: the required flags are source-level delivery diagnostics, not real Host acceptance. Native personalization, theme tokens, brand slots and two independent public model-label preferences have reviewed public contracts and regression coverage. Unsupported native layout, workspace and context contracts remain false. Suite uses only declared public Host metadata, version-agnostic capability fallback and optional read-only Locale subscription. Network proxy, Vision Bridge, native DOM takeover, private Workspace wrappers, raw Gateway credential resolution and Suite-owned MCP credential editing are retired. Gateway Effort automatic sync remains disabled; the pure adapter is not runtime delivery. Official session-log exclusion does not prove all Host telemetry is disabled. Historical p0_* and audit_stage_1 entries below describe the evidence available at their recorded stage, not current blockers. See current_evidence for the latest recorded verified source baseline; real Host/Windows/second Host version acceptance remains unverified.
